summary: App amendments requested: fix Service/Product category dropdown text overlap and add bilingual reverse-charge (0%) comment for §13b UStG.
known_issues: Service/Product category dropdown text overlaps other text (needs UI fix).

existing_features.title: Fix the “Service/Product Category” dropdown UI so the selected value is always clearly readable and never overlaps with other text in the control (including in narrow/mobile layouts).

When the VAT result is reverse-charge with 0% VAT, display a two-line comment directly under the reverse-charge output: line 1 (German) must be exactly “Steuerschuldnerschaft des Leistungsempfängers (§13b UStG)”; line 2 (English) must be exactly “Tax liability of the recipient of services (§13b UStG)”.

When generating the invoice preview for a reverse-charge (0%) result, include the same bilingual §13b comment as the legal VAT note in the invoice content: first the German line “Steuerschuldnerschaft des Leistungsempfängers (§13b UStG)”, then a new line with the English line “Tax liability of the recipient of services (§13b UStG)”.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix Service/Product category dropdown so it displays clearly without text overlapping.

For reverse charge of 0%, display comment in German "Steuerschuldnerschaft des Leistungsempfängers (§13b UStG)" with English translation "Tax liability of the recipient of services (§13b UStG)" underneath.

projectName: Fix Service/Product category dropdown overlap and add bilingual §13b reverse-charge note
